# raft/CLAUDE.md, "Propose a forward each time it is delivered" (#401,
# mutForwardNoDedupe): one forward delivered twice is appended once, and both
# deliveries are answered with its position.

----
ok

campaign 1 elect
----
ok

  seq=1
  HardState term=2 vote=1 commit=0

  Membership 1@0 2@0 3@0

ok

    1/2 noop
  Messages:

    1->3 MsgApp term=2 [1/2 noop]

ok
